evidence.detail: R180 SwingUtil.createTrayIcon(Image,String,Frame) constructs rs/gui/N with the supplied Frame and installs it directly on the newly created TrayIcon through addMouseListener.

mouseClicked makes the supplied Frame visible and sets Frame state 0 (normal). Under one exact rs/k/j mode, if the frame is not focused it briefly hides the frame and invokes rs/A/o.b() before restoring it.
The class stores only the target Frame and owns no other UI, packet or client state.

evidence.detail: The class stores one java.awt.Image plus x/y draw coordinates and a constructor-supplied integer mode/state.
Its String loader supports development/file execution by Toolkit.getImage(path) and packaged execution by getResource + ImageIO.read, returning whether an Image was successfully obtained.
The class can replace its Image, update draw coordinates, and draw the Image through a Graphics2D copy at those coordinates.

Exact-v308 consumers use this type for loadout backgrounds, prayer/skill/book-tag assets, item/icon caching and enum-backed GUI icons; R280 neighboring rs/gui/y and z occupy stable IDs 000286/000287, fixing this missing helper at 000285.
